tool_args.rationale: The pilot and open-branch observations show saturation and sink-gradient inhibition, but leave trajectory and initial-state dependence unconstrained. A trajectory batch can distinguish candidate dynamic mechanisms before confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a saturating, gradient-inhibited transfer law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The seven observations all share the same horizon, initial state, past input, and memory, so their effects and the underlying dynamics are not identifiable.
It has already supplied gradient variation but does not resolve the fixed-horizon trajectory ambiguity.
It is irrelevant to identifying the transfer law.
